title: Reports of Condensation and Mould on Walls and Ceilings due to Neighbours' Use of Air-conditioners
what_it_is: Reports of Condensation and Mould on Walls and Ceilings due to Neighbours' Use of Air-conditioners

sections.label: HDB condensation and mould feedback
sections.summary: HDB received about 240 condensation and mould feedback cases in 2025 and inspects, advises owners and neighbours, and recommends ventilation and mould-resistant paint.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In 2025, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) received a total of about 240 cases of feedback regarding condensation and mould on walls or ceilings arising from neighbours' use of air-conditioners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Upon receiving such feedback, HDB will conduct inspections to determine the cause of the condensation and mould, and provide appropriate advice to the flat owners and neighbours, including how they are using their air-conditioners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We also recommend flat owners to keep rooms well-ventilated to minimise mould growth and consider the use of mould-resistant paint as a preventive measure.

sections.label: HDB air-conditioner usage advisory
sections.summary: HDB can advise neighbours on air-conditioner usage, will explore wall and ceiling enhancements, and may share compensation based on case specifics.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: HDB can consider providing an advisory to the neighbours on proper usage of air-conditioners, for instance, when it comes to the length of air-conditioning use or temperature settings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As to her suggestion on wall and ceiling enhancements, HDB has to explore if these enhancements will truly work.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And as for whether or not we could stipulate them, I think we will have to take a look the specific circumstances, the specific cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Where there are egregious uses where it has led to damage in the corresponding neighbour's flat, then based on the case specifics, we will have to see how the compensation can be best shared by the two individuals.
